title: Unless & Provided That
goal: Distinguish a menos que, con tal de que and siempre que + subjunctive to state exact conditions
grammar: conditional-conjunctions: a menos que (exception) vs con tal de que / siempre que (requirement) + subjunctive

items: I can state a sole exception with *a menos que* / *salvo que* + subjunctive.
I can set a binding condition with *con tal de que* and *siempre que* + subjunctive.
I can use scheduling and agreement vocabulary like *el anexo*, *el margen*, *el compromiso*, *adelantar* and *posponer*.
